title: The Attachment Anchor
description: Assess your deep-seated attachment style. Discover how your 'Internal Working Model' shapes your reaction to intimacy.

questions.text: When a partner or close friend is emotionally available and supportive, I feel...

options.text: Safe and deserving of it.
Happy, but waiting for it to end.
Uncomfortable; I don't know how to handle it.
Suspicious; I feel they want something from me.

questions.text: In conflict, my primary fear is...

options.text: That we won't solve the specific problem.
That they are mad at me.
That they will leave me if I speak up.
That I will be trapped or controlled.

questions.text: I find that I 'test' people's loyalty by pulling away or acting out...

options.text: Never.
Rarely.
Often; I need to see if they'll chase me.
Constantly; it's the only way I feel safe.

insight_cloud.title: Attachment Styles
insight_cloud.text: Attachment isn't just about 'clinging' or 'running'. It's your brain's learned strategy for survival. Shifting from Anxious or Avoidant to 'Earned Secure' is possible through consistent, safe interactions.

questions.text: When I am single or alone, my sense of 'self' feels...

options.text: Whole and capable.
A bit lonely but okay.
Fragile; I need someone to mirror me.
Non-existent; I am only 'real' in a relationship.

questions.text: Do you feel like you are repeating the exact same 'relationship plot' with different people?

options.text: No.
Occasionally.
Yes, I'm stuck in a loop.
Yes, and it's destroying my life.
